Name: Gastein waterfall
Tip: Go early or in the evening when it is quiet – and look at the hotels around it.

Name: Landawirsee in the Lungau
Tip: Start early, check the weather forecast and reserve the hut if you want to stay overnight.

Name: Belle Époque architecture & Straubinger Platz
Tip: Go to the waterfall in the evening and look at the lights of the hotels.

Name: Felsentherme Bad Gastein
Tip: Plan the spa for the afternoon after a hike.

Name: Stubnerkogel & suspension bridge
Tip: Go up in clear weather and early in the day.

Name: Graukogel – a quieter hiking summit
Tip: Start early and use the mid-station if you want a shorter hike.

Name: Empress Elisabeth Promenade
Tip: Go in the morning and combine it with a café visit.

Name: Mauterndorf Castle in the Lungau
Tip: Combine the castle with a detour to the Landawirsee hike.

Name: Gastein Healing Gallery – warmth in the mountain
Tip: Ask your doctor beforehand whether it is suitable for you.
